verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is an evaluation doc saying evaluators can send "the images and audio attached to your spans" to an LLM judge. That implies spans can carry image and audio payloads, but it does not document how a developer captures them during instrumentation. Missing for 10: first-party docs on attaching images/audio to spans via the SDK, any evidence for file payloads, supported formats and size limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces

citations.quote: Evaluators can also send the images and audio attached to your spans to the LLM judge.
